detail: Category scorers (sequencing, scope quality, argument quality, decision hygiene, workflow completeness, anti-patterns, quality criteria) group logically. Hybrid approach gives traceability back to BEHAVIORS.md rule IDs while allowing sophisticated check logic that can't be expressed as rule strings. Scorers return both numeric 0-1 and pass/fail checks for thresholds and diagnostics respectively.
summary: 7 category scorers with hybrid rule mapping: metadata from BehaviorSpec, custom check logic inline
